attempted_axis: Enumerate and CLASSIFY every dangling citation `gdlmem validate` reports as corpus debt, with a per-item disposition (prune / repair / keep-by-design), and check whether the same debt exists where validate cannot see it.

attributes.law_screen: none applicable: this item reads record metadata, not codegen. The governing rules are AGENTS.md's 'Update facts by superseding records, never by deleting them', the parked-record hygiene duty (prune-attempts), the cross-fleet release protocol (a released work_claim's inbox file is DELETED, not superseded) and validate's own dangling_note.

attributes.residual: FIVE CLASSES, all 67 instances accounted for. CLASS A -- KEEP BY DESIGN, 7 instances / 6 ids: `refutes: work_claim.*` on records that refuted their own dispatch premise (attempt.DA_doworldanimation..., attempt.DA_fn80051480..., attempt.MT_msl-trigf-region-was-already-complete-before-dispatch, attempt.SF_tier1-count-mismatch-premise-refuted, attempt.T16_two-queue-premises-refuted..., attempt.WF_camera-mode-level-inverse-premise-refuted, attempt.ZI_zlib-inflate-lane-premise-refuted...). These are MANUFACTURED BY THE WORKFLOW: AGENTS.md discipline 5 requires a refuted premise to be recorded with a `refutes` citation, and the cross-fleet protocol requires the work_claim to be DELETED on release. Pruning the citation would destroy the only record of WHICH dispatch premise was refuted. Disposition: keep, and either exempt `work_claim.*` targets from the count or retain a released claim as a tombstone. CLASS B -- REPAIRABLE, 8 instances / 6 ids, the only cheaply fixable part of the 67. Seven are versionless law ids in `laws_applied`: claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast (attempt.player-tu-defakematch.20260831.v3), claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web (same record, plus attempt.screensaver-c-defakematch-tupass.20260830.v2 and attempt.tower-c-defakematch-tupass.20260830.v1), claim.law.swap-loop-is-record-layout-ground-truth (same record), claim.law.fuzzy-can-underweight-a-real-improvement (attempt.dcshandlerequest-index-li.20260831.v2), claim.law.raw-offset-form-supplies-value-identity-not-addressing-shape (attempt.gamemode-header-promotion.20260831.v1) -- each resolves by appending the one live version suffix. The eighth is a DATE typo: attempt.initeffects-null-arm-base-relative-w2.20260831.v1 cites claim.law.offsetof-rename-safe-on-capped-and-parked-functions.20260830.v1 and the record is .20260831.v1. CAVEAT THAT MAKES THIS AN INTEGRATOR DECISION, NOT A CHORE: `laws_applied` is what the build materialises into per-law application counts, so repairing these seven ADDS applications to five laws and MOVES their derived evidence scores -- a repair that changes the numbers other lanes screen on. CLASS C -- HISTORICAL, 12 instances / 12 ids: `supersedes` pointing at `attempt.parked.*` ids deleted by the documented 2026-08-30 migration of the claim.parked-unresolved blob (audiosetupbossstreams, controlsupdate, critterdotexmodnode, dcshandlerequest, fn_8001267c, fn_800d87fc, initeffects, mbox_bgloadmodelstart, registeritemwobj, resolveworlddata, sysresetservice, towercheckmessages). Disposition: keep; they name what was superseded and the migration is documented. CLASS D -- LOST, 1 instance: claim.law.split-bss-symbols-are-one-record-and-array-form-defeats-synthesized-index-base.20260831.v2 supersedes a .v1 that the corpus never retained. Disposition: annotate the v2, since nothing can resolve it. CLASS E -- THE DOCUMENTED PRUNE OUTPUT, 39 instances / 33 ids: `supersedes` edges stranded by prune-attempts cap ejections, exactly what validate's dangling_note describes. Disposition: keep. NET: 8 of 67 are repairable, 59 are structural or historical, and the single undifferentiated count is what makes the debt look actionable when 88% of it is not. A CLASS THE VALIDATOR CANNOT SEE, measured because a defect record must screen for what else has its shape: validate checks STRUCTURED citation fields inside records and nothing reads config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json's prose, where a shipped rule's SOURCE-EXHAUSTION PROVENANCE lives. Scanning the 113 mechanism-bearing pins found 210 record-id citations and FIVE dangling ids across FOURTEEN rule entries: attempt.HV_union-resweep-eight-composed-closes.20260901.v1 (nine pins -- critter::CritterLineRootColSub, enemy::fn_8004646C, controls::MtapOpenPort, mb_font::MBRenderText, movieplayer::__ct__11MoviePlayerFv, movieplayer::fn_800D91B4, camera::camera_mode_target, newcam::fn_8006DF34, tower::TowerCheckMessages; `gdlmem search "resweep"` returns claim.HV_union-resweep-closability-roster-and-its-refusal-taxonomy.20260901.v1 and NOT this attempt), attempt.HV_harvest-sweep-arrow-order.20260901.v1 (atree::DoAnimateTreeFrame, screensaver::end_inventory_panel; `gdlmem search "HV harvest sweep arrow order"` returns only claim.HV_regfield-only-class-full-image-sweep-and-its-exhaustion.20260901.v1), attempt.MP_fn800d87fc-additive-spelling-dead-and-the-residual-needs-a-range-proof.20260901.v1 (movieplayer::fn_800D87FC -- this one IS in validate's 58, pruned and superseded by attempt.WF_fn800d87fc-range-proof-class-closes-the-mask-and-unblocks-the-composition.20260901.v1, so the pin inherited a known dangler), attempt.HV_gauntworld-preheader-constant-permute.20260901.v1 (gauntworld::fn_8005FB48 -- a MISSPELLING, the record is attempt.HV_fn8005fb48-preheader-constant-permute.20260901.v1), and 'claim.law.HB_two-censuses-...v1' (critter::CritterLineRootColSub -- an ELIDED id, the record is claim.law.HB_two-censuses-can-both-miss-a-function-and-a-classifier-that-omits-an-arrow-mis-tiers-not-just-miscounts.20260901.v1; the ellipsis idiom is used inside accepted records too, where it is equally unresolvable). Two of the five are repairable spellings; eleven of the fourteen pin entries name provenance that does not exist in the corpus at all.
